description: This Java source file defines the HttpPublisherActor class, an Akka actor responsible for publishing messages to an HTTP endpoint, handling request creation, response processing, and error handling within the Eclipse Ditto project.

classes.name: HttpPublisherActor
classes.description: An Akka actor responsible for publishing messages via HTTP, managing request flow, response handling, and error propagation within the Eclipse Ditto framework.

methods.name: props
methods.description: Creates Props for actor instantiation with connection and factory parameters.

methods.name: postStop
methods.description: Shuts down the kill switch and performs cleanup when actor stops.

methods.name: shouldPublishAcknowledgement
methods.description: Determines if an acknowledgement should be published based on its label.

methods.name: preEnhancement
methods.description: Hook for pre-processing receive builder; no operation here.

methods.name: postEnhancement
methods.description: Adds handling for ConnectionFailure messages after main receive setup.

methods.name: toPublishTarget
methods.description: Converts a string address to an HttpPublishTarget object.

methods.name: publishMessage
methods.description: Main method to publish a message, creating HTTP request, context, and queuing for sending.

methods.name: createRequest
methods.description: Constructs an HttpRequest from the message and target, including headers and payload.

methods.name: getHttpHeadersPair
methods.description: Extracts headers and content type from message headers.

methods.name: handleQueueOfferResult
methods.description: Handles the result of offering a request to the queue, managing errors and backpressure.

methods.name: processResponse
methods.description: Processes HTTP responses asynchronously, invoking response handlers.

methods.name: newContext
methods.description: Creates a context object for handling the response, including logging and error handling.

methods.name: toCommandResponseOrAcknowledgement
methods.description: Converts an HTTP response into a command response or acknowledgement, validating response content.

methods.name: validateLiveResponse
methods.description: Validates that the live response matches the expected message command, checking IDs and types.

methods.name: handleInvalidResponse
methods.description: Handles invalid responses by logging and throwing exceptions.

methods.name: toMessageCommandResponse
methods.description: Converts JSON body to a message command response, handling protocol-specific parsing.

methods.name: toCommandResponse
methods.description: Parses JSON object into a CommandResponse signal.

methods.name: toConnectionFailure
methods.description: Creates a ConnectionFailure object from stream termination info.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Sets Ditto-specific headers based on HTTP response headers.

methods.name: getPayloadAsBytes
methods.description: Returns message payload as byte array, depending on message type.

methods.name: getTextPayload
methods.description: Retrieves text payload from message.

methods.name: getBytePayload
methods.description: Retrieves byte payload from message.

methods.name: getResponseBody
methods.description: Reads and interprets the body of an HTTP response, converting to JSON value.

methods.name: stripUserInfo
methods.description: Removes user info from a URI.
